question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Making notes will ________ you to organize your thoughts in a better way.
solution:
The correct answer is **enable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Enable: **to make it possible for somebody/something to do something.

 
 
• **Example: ***Digitalisation has **enabled **us to save a lot of resources. *
 
 
 
• The word **enable** has been used here in the sense that note-making helps in organizing one's thoughts in a better way.
 
• The word that must be filled in the blank should be a **'verb'** it is preceded by a helping verb **'****will'**.
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Capable: **having the ability or qualities necessary to do something.
 
• **Disable: **to make somebody unable to use part of his/her body properly.
 
• **Adjustable: **that can be adjusted.
